title: Import & Export
notes: Import history (settings/import) now uses the ListPage archetype with infinite scroll, hover row actions, skeleton and empty state, all wired to the real GET /imports endpoint. Export jobs table (settings/export) could not get the same treatment: there is no GET /exports (list) endpoint in this manifest, only GET /exports/jobs/:id for a known job id, so it remains a client-side session log of jobs started/refreshed this session rather than a paginated ListPage — flag to inventory/backend if a real list endpoint should exist. relationCombobox/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/datePicker/sendMessageDialog/detailDrawer/themedExport are not applicable: this slice has no relation fields, contact fields, or entity records to export — it's an upload wizard + job history, not an entity CRUD form. Did not verify the P0 MASTER_DB cross-tenant note — that's backend/src/queues, out of scope for this slice job. The importsApi.upload preview/mapping data (headers/previewData) is returned live from POST /imports/upload, not hardcoded — did not find a mock-data import to remove.
showcaseScript: Upload a file and map the columns
Run the import and watch live progress
Export leads as a branded Excel file
